name: @fsapro/forma
description: Forma by FSA — design system, peaux Foundation et Lab. Tokens DTCG, CSS de composants, comportements et thème ECharts, sans dépendance ni build côté consommateur.

scripts.test:js: node --check dist/forma.js && node -e "import('./dist/forma.echarts.js').then(m => { if (!m.formaTheme({ skin: 'lab', theme: 'dark' }).color.length) process.exit(1); })"
scripts.verify: npm run build && git diff --exit-code dist && npm run test:contrast && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:js
